# Stain Solver

> Spilled coffee, wine or grease? Get a stain-removal first move tailored to your fabric. Three quick choices, practical steps, and source-backed safety guidance.

Stain Solver is a free, account-free household guide. It turns published cleaning and textile-care sources into cautious, fabric-specific first steps. It does not claim laboratory testing, guaranteed removal, or a live inspection of a garment. The care label and the maker's directions come first.

## Pages

- [Home](https://stainsolver.shop/): Spilled coffee, wine or grease? Get a stain-removal first move tailored to your fabric. Three quick choices, practical steps, and source-backed safety guidance.
- [Stain guides](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/): Care-aware guides for common spills on cotton, denim, sofas, carpet, wool, silk and more. Browse by stain and material.
- [How our advice works](https://stainsolver.shop/about/): How Stain Solver turns public cleaning and textile-care resources into conservative fabric-aware first steps, with safety rules and references.
- [Privacy](https://stainsolver.shop/privacy/): Stain Solver is free and accountless. Your saved stain plans live in your browser; there are no analytics trackers or external user accounts.
- [Interactive stain desk](https://stainsolver.shop/solve/): Choose the spill, the material, and whether the stain is fresh or dried. Get practical first steps with warnings and sources. Plans are built in the browser. This address is a utility page and is not intended for indexing.

## Guides

- [Coffee on white cotton](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/coffee-on-white-cotton/): Coffee on white cotton: White cotton is usually launderable, but the care symbol still controls wash temperature and which products may be used.
- [Coffee on coloured cotton](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/coffee-on-coloured-cotton/): Coffee on coloured cotton: Coloured cotton needs a dye-transfer check.
- [Coffee on fabric sofa](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/coffee-on-sofa/): Coffee on fabric sofa: Fabric upholstery must be treated according to its cleaning code. A missing code is a reason to pause, not a reason to guess with water.
- [Coffee on wool](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/coffee-on-wool/): Coffee on wool: Wool can be damaged by inappropriate detergents or rough handling.
- [Coffee on silk](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/coffee-on-silk/): Coffee on silk: Silk is vulnerable to water marks, colour migration and finish damage.
